public_reference.value:
Applicants are nominated by their home university and managed within a partner-framework agreement. Before applying contact the International Office ( exchangestud uni-trier de ), which offers information about the application process via the Admissions Office, room availability and participation in German language Course.
Have you been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University? If so, let yourself be inspired by the variety of courses! At Trier University, you can expand your studies according to your wishes with a German perspective on your field of study and beyond. The Orientation Programme for international students makes it easier for you to settle into student life in Trier.
If you are a student participating in an exchange programme (e.g. ERASMUS, ISEP, partner universities) and have been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University, you will find information here on your application and admission to Trier University.
ⓘ Your application form is only valid if your home university has confirmed your nomination by signing and stamping your application form.

Gather additional information on the courses offered by the subjects on the websites of the subjects for exchange students (there you will usually find course lists from the current semesters and information on credit allocation). These and the contact persons in the subjects, who you can also contact with specific questions about course selection, can be found here.
Language Courses: Would you also like to learn German or other languages at Trier University? Then take a look at the courses offered by the Language Centre. The Language Centre is part of the University and the courses are free of charge for all Trier University students. German Courses: Each semester, intensive courses as well as additional module courses are offered at various proficiency levels (typically A and B levels). If you have any questions about German courses, please contact: Ms. Zita van Wylick (ECTS Coordinator for German Courses). Registration for the courses and the placement test generally take place during the week before the start of the lecture period or the orientation program. A preliminary overview in English can be found here.
After arrival at Trier University, you will receive your Trier student ID card, the "Tunika". You will receive authorization to use the computers at the University, including instructions on how to access the Wi-Fi on campus, your own email address and the course catalogue (PORTA) well before arrival.
How to sign up for exams is covered on these pages: 🡒 Course selection 🡒 End of Stay

Im Gegensatz zu den Studentenwohnheimen der Universität Trier und einigen privat betriebenen Studentenwohnheimen sind die meisten Zimmer/Wohnungen auf dem privaten Wohnungsmarkt unmöbliert. Bei einigen Wohnungsangeboten ist auch keine Küche inklusive. Es ist ratsam, dies vor dem Einzug genau zu klären.
Sowohl private Wohnungen als auch Wohnheimzimmer haben in Deutschland immer eine Kündigungsfrist. Diese wird in der Regel im Vertrag festgelegt und beträgt etwa drei Monate. Ein vorzeitiger Auszug ist nicht möglich, daher sollten Sie sich an die Fristen halten.
If you would like the International Office to arrange accommodation for you, please send us the "Application for Accommodation" in writing. You can find this form in the online application portal.
Students from the United Kingdom (UK) are advised to apply for a visa for their stay in Trier before arrival. It is possible to apply for a residence permit instead of a visa after arrival, but this can be more difficult than applying for a visa in advance due to changing guidelines.

Please note that in advance of your studies at Trier University, the financing for your complete stay in Germany must be clarified and secured. You will need at least 992 euros per month to finance your life in Trier. Most of the costs will be for rent, health insurance and your meals. In your first month, you will also have other costs. Usually you will have to pay a deposit for your flat. You will also have to pay the semester fee, which is currently around 380 euros. In order to apply for a visa, you will need to provide ⭷ proof of financial resources . In other words, you must prove that you can finance your studies in Trier.

Erstmals können die Studierenden dabei im Bachelor, Master und Doktorat jeweils bis zu 12 Monate gefördert werden. Um den finanziellen Anreiz für einen Auslandsaufenthalt zu erhöhen, wird zudem der monatliche Mobilitätszuschuss für die Studierenden angehoben, insbesondere für Gastländer mit höheren Lebenshaltungskosten. Praktika im Ausland sind künftig auch nach Studienabschluss möglich. Schließlich bietet Erasmus+ Studierenden, die ein ganzes Master-Studium in Europa absolvieren möchten, die Möglichkeit, dafür ein zinsgünstiges Darlehen aufzunehmen. Die bisherige Exzellenz-Förderung von Erasmus Mundus, die das ganze Master-Studium von hervorragenden Studierenden in ausgewählten europäischen Masterprogrammen mit gemeinsamem Abschluss unterstützt, wird unter Erasmus+ fortgesetzt.
The financial support for Erasmus+ mobilities for the purpose of teaching or training depends on the varying living costs in each destination country (“programme countries”). Consistent daily rates apply for funding by German universities.
Die finanzielle Förderung von Erasmus-Mobilitäten zur Fort- und Weiterbildung orientiert sich an den unterschiedlichen Lebenshaltungskosten in den Zielländern („Programmländer“). Es gelten einheitliche Tagessätze für die Förderung durch deutsche Hochschulen.

public_reference.value:
The period of required coverage is the actual duration of the exchange visitor’s participation in the sponsor’s exchange visitor program as recorded in SEVIS in the “Program Begin Date,” and as applicable, the “Program End Date,” “Effective Program End Date,” or “Effective Date of Termination” fields. Sponsors are not authorized to charge fees to their sponsored exchange visitors for the provision of insurance coverage beyond any demonstrable and justifiable staff time. Sponsors are not required to, but may, offer supplemental “entry to exit” coverage (i.e., coverage from the time the exchange visitor departs his or her home country until he or she returns). If the sponsor provides health insurance or arranges for health insurance to be offered to the exchange visitor, via payroll deduction at the host organization, the exchange visitor must voluntarily authorize this action in writing and also be given the opportunity to make other arrangements to obtain insurance. These authorizations must be kept on file by the sponsor.

Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. Foreigners who hold a valid residence permit and have changed passports or had other items on the residence permit changed shall apply to the exit and entry administration authority of public security organs for information update within 10 days from the date the changes occur.
在大陆停居留的台湾居民应当按照《中国公民往来台湾地区管理办法》的规定办理住宿登记后申请办理台胞证。
台湾居民在大陆向出入境管理机构申请换发或补发台湾居民来往大陆通行证时，发现其未办理住宿登记。
In recent years, SWU has increased the investment in the construction and renovation of international student dormitories to ensure the development of student accommodation needs, while improving the hardware facilities of international student dormitories , the use of classified placement of student accommodation methods, with professional property management services, to create a safe, orderly, civilized and clean accommodation environment for students.

（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

If you apply to HZ before 1 May , you are guaranteed housing for the duration of your studies through our housing partner. Once you have registered at HZ, you can start looking at the available accommodation and book your room yourself. We recommend booking as early as possible, preferably in early spring, so you have the best choice of room

public_reference.value:
We recommend student accommodation for at least your first year of study, giving you time to settle into your new routine. We find that students who choose to live in student accommodation in the first year are generally better prepared to thrive in shared or private rental accommodation in subsequent years.
Most student accommodation comes fully furnished and equipped with essential resources for effective study. In most cases, utilities and wifi are connected, and these costs are included in your accommodation fee, making it easy for you to budget your finances.
Choosing where to live is one of the most important decisions you’ll make during your studies. While many students opt for student accommodation , Adelaide offers several alternatives including private rental, share accommodation and homestays. You can also access temporary accommodation in hostels, hotels and serviced apartments for short periods.
Private rental and share accommodation refer to residential properties available for rent, or individual bedrooms in established households.

Slovenians with no Slovenian citizenship receiving a scholarship by the Republic of Slovenia (Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia) may apply for a room at the Student resident halls. The Regulations on fees and accommodation in students’ dormitories for Slovene nationals without Slovene citizenship and foreigners in the Republic of Slovenia provide that up to 250 places are to be offered in Student resident halls for the recipients of ministry scholarship. Available places for the residence of scholarship recipients are assigned by the Ministry responsible for higher education in cooperation with scholarship providers. Recipients of ministry scholarships are charged a subsidized rent. The Ministry or scholarship provider pays the rent directly to the student dorm, i.e. from the scholarship amount granted.

Study program and level 3 rd year Bachelor’s student in Marketing at the School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana, English track
About me Hello! My name is Una Lajić and I am currently in the last year of my undergraduate studies as a Marketing student at the School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana. Since moving to Slovenia in 2023, I quickly integrated within the new environment, joining and becoming an active member of the student organisation of SEB LU all in the first week of my 1st year. Becoming an International Student Ambassador for the University of Ljubljana two years ago, I have actively taken on the responsibility of promoting and representing the institution, facilitating guidance to international students during the adaptation process regarding studies and integration into the new life in Slovenia. Taking into account that I have been in the same shoes you are currently in, facing numerous decisions ahead, knowing how difficult it is to leave your country, choose the right faculty and a place that you will call your new home, I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the university and student life here in Ljubljana!

public_reference.value:
NB. If a “NO” button is selected, whilst the student is staying in an accredited accommodation, the student will be liable for the transport cost or it will be at his/her own account
The Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) is one of the largest residential educational institutions in South Africa. There are private student accommodation options, but first-year students should apply and register for University-owned accommodation, managed by ARLC. ARLC accommodation has the advantage of being on campus, or reliable transport provided by the University, if situated off campus. ARLC residences are furthermore well managed with experienced residence advisors, a strong governance system with many residence life opportunities organised by residence committees. There is furthermore a mentorship programme, according to which residents are placed according to course of study. Mentors are appointed for each resident to provide academic and mental well-being support.
Facilities for students with disabilities Some residences are equipped to accommodate disabled students. Disabilities must be clearly indicated on the University application form to ensure admission to the most suitable residence. Laundry facilities Washing machines and tumble dryers are available to residents at residences.

Learning Agreement – the document with the selected courses at VMU. First, check the course catalogue for more information. Note: You may select the courses almost from all the VMU faculties/academies. The exception applies to art/music area courses. They are available only to the students majoring in art/music. Pay attention to the location, as courses are offered in two cities: Kaunas and Vilnius. The required amount of credits is 24 - 36 ECTS per semester. Second , list the courses in the form of the Learning Agreement , sign it and ask your home university's international programme coordinator to sign it. Third , list the selected (and confirmed by your home university) courses in your online application form ( follow the application instructions sent via e-mail after your home university nominates you ). Fourth, attach the signed Learning Agreement to your online application form ( follow the application instructions sent via e-mail after your home university nominates you ).
When the selection is made, partner university should send the Nomination letter to VMU: erasmus@vdu.lt .

First, check the course catalogue for more information. Note: You may select the courses almost from all the VMU faculties/academies. The exception applies to art/music area courses. They are available only to the students majoring in art/music. Pay attention to the location, as courses are offered in two cities: Kaunas and Vilnius. The required amount of credits is 24 - 36 ECTS per semester.
Course Catalogue for Exchange Students
What are the student selection criteria in the competition for studies abroad? Students' selection criteria are: academic results of 2 last semesters, compatibility of courses between home and host universities, motivation, level of English and other foreign languages k n owledge . How to choose the university for studies abroad? For studies in EU countries: See the list of announced universities for the ongoing competition, choose the country/university according to your department/study field and check the course catalogues pu b lished on the websites of host universities. Contact the VMU academic coordinator regarding the courses’ compatibility. For studies in non-EU countries: See the list of announced universities for the ongoing competition, choose the country and check the course catalogues pu b lished on the websites of host universities. Contact the VMU academic coordinator regarding the courses’ compatibility. Note: pay attention to the language of instruction and evaluate if your level of foreign language knowledge is sufficient. Will my courses be recognized when I return? The students must carefully choose the university by checking the course catalogue announced for the incoming exchange students on the websites of host universities before submitting the application for the scholarship competition. Academic coordinators in the faculties are ready to answer all your studies-related questions. The courses will be recognized after you return if the Learning Agreement (a document which consists of the list of courses approved by the sending and receiving universities) is submitted properly. What are the accommodation possibilities abroad? Many universities offer dormitory accommodation. Students prefer choosing this type of accommodation for better integration. Some universities cannot offer enough places in dormitories, therefore students need to check this information beforehand. Please note: accommodation fees in the USA are higher than in other countries: ~10.000 $/semester. How can I get more practical information about host universities? Contact the exchange programmes' ambassadors for more practical information.

Living in the VMU Dormitory together with other international students
Accommodation The university accommodation is being organized by VMU Student Affairs Department. The accommodation information can be found HERE . The number of available places of VMU dormitory accommodation is limited and offered on a first come - first serve basis for the students who apply with the online accommodation form. The VMU Student Affairs Department opens the accommodation application form in July (for the autumn semester students) and in December (for the spring semester students). Health Insurance Health Insurance is one of the obligatory requirements for all international students at Vytautas Magnus University which should be taken care of before the students’ arrival. Please find the following information HERE . Visa Application Non-EU or non-EFTA country citizens should apply for multiple entry National visas (D). Please check the Visa Guide for more information. The prospective students are provided with the instructions sent by e-mail by VMU exchange coordinator. VMU Mentors' Programme VMU Mentor’s programme aims to make the adaptation process of incoming international students at Vytautas Magnus University (VMU) easier. Please find more information about this programme HERE . Learning Lithuanian Before visiting Lithuania you may want to learn how to say “hello”, “thank you”, “how could I find this and that” or maybe even more – to keep up a conversation in one of the oldest language in the world – Lithuanian. Please find the most useful information about Lithuanian learning possibilities HERE . Arrival and Registration at VMU All students are required to follow the information regarding the arrival and registration published HERE .
Rentum.eu is a free housing platform that matches suitable flats, rooms and potential flatmates in Lithuania.
Student Residence Hall ™ is a space where students can enjoy a superb lifestyle with the best rooms. This history building located in old city center. In 2022 it was renovated with love to include newly furnished attic rooms. The building has a completely equipped kitchens, studying and leisure zones, laundry rooms, and its own dedicated high speed wireless internet connection. All taxes and utilities (Wi-Fi, heating, electricity, gas, and water) are included in the rent price.

Spotahome is the safest way to book mid- to long-term accommodation in Europe, directly from your mobile phone. The homes advertised on our site are personally visited by one of our Homecheckers, professional photographers who take high-quality photos, create an HD video tour, detailed ﬂoor plans and honest descriptions of the property and neighbourhood. The most complete property listings mean that you can view, choose and book your property directly online, and enjoy a discount on the booking fee with your partner promo code.
Once the booking request has been submitted, we will forward it to the landlord, who has 24 working hours to respond. When the landlord accepts your booking, we will conﬁrm it to you via email and share your details with them and vice versa. At this time we will also take payment for the ﬁrst month’s rent and booking fee automatically. If the landlord does not accept your booking, we will offer you similar accommodation options or alternatively you may also choose a full refund.

public_reference.value:
How easy is this? All your daily destinations — the places you hit to rest, recharge, and relax — are tucked into a compact campus shaded by towering trees and crisscrossed by walking paths. Cozy. Close. Convenient. With a variety of housing and dining options, you’ll find a space that feels like home.
Summer housing is available only for undergraduate TCNJ students enrolled in summer classes, working full-time for a college department, participating in a summer program approved by Residential Education and Housing (i.e. MUSE), or those experiencing housing insecurity. Summer housing will be located in Hausdoerffer or Phelps Hall for Session 1, 2, 3 and all of MUSE. Students living on campus for the upcoming Fall semester that are here for Session 3 will be asked to move in to that assignment early. Although rare, students who are here for consecutive sessions may be required to move rooms in order to maximize our space and occupancy needs.
What is the cost of Winter Break Housing? Students can view all housing rates on our room and board rates webpage . No meal plan will be available for the winter session. Information on whether or not a Dining location will be open in the Student Center will be forthcoming. When is the application deadline for Winter Break Housing? Applications need to be submitted through MyHousing by 11:59pm on Sunday, November 30, 2025 in order for the student to move in on Monday, December 22, 2025 or  Monday, December 29th, 2025.  Applications will continue to be accepted after Sunday, November 30th, 2025, based on availability of spaces. Information on how students will be able to move into their Travers or Wolfe room will be sent to students after they apply and are assigned. Where do students live for the winter? For the winter session students may be required to consolidate in to Travers and Wolfe Halls. Specific details and instructions for winter housing locations will be provided closer to the start of this period. Is there a meal plan associated with Winter Break Housing? There will not be a meal plan associated with winter housing. Winter Break Housing residents will have ID access to the Townhouse South kitchen (within the South lounge.) Please make appropriate preparations for food over the course of your winter stay. What if I need to cancel my Winter Break Housing application? Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

TCNJ is connected to public transportation through New Jersey Transit ( NJTransit.com ). The bus that comes on campus is the 601, and other lines are walking distance from the campus. The 601 will connect you to the Trenton Transit Center, where you can connect to NJTransit trains to Newark Liberty International Airport and New York City, SEPTA trains to Philadelphia, and Amtrak trains that can take you to major cities throughout the U.S.
There is a small airport within walking distance of the campus, Trenton/Mercer Airport. The only commercial airline that flies from this airport is Frontier Airlines, with flights to cities in Florida year round and flights to Atlanta and Chicago seasonally.

content_review.quote:
Internationalization | UADE International | UADE | Universidad Argentina de la Empresa
Banner UADE
INTERNATIONALIZATION
Discover key facts and opportunities about UADE’s international initiatives.
Internationalization at Home
Through “internationalization at home” activities, UADE students have the opportunity to access intercultural experiences directly at the university, in their classes, or even from their homes.
Highlighted Initiatives
COIL with CEU San Pablo (Spain):
Nutrition and Biotechnology students participate in a Collaborative Online International Learning project with CEU San Pablo (Spain). This initiative integrates international knowledge and perspectives through digital platforms, fostering interdisciplinary work and a global outlook.
International Seminar – Prof. Andreas Moerke (Germany):
Professor Andreas Moerke from the University of Worms (Germany) delivered a specialized seminar as part of UADE’s 2025 international academic agenda.
International Professors – Florida International University (USA):
Two professors from Florida International University taught within UADE’s regular courses, enriching our students’ learning experience with a global perspective.

public_reference.value:
Grâce à un partenariat exclusif avec les résidences ECLA, nos étudiants bénéficient d’avantages privilégiés : une remise sur les frais de dossier ainsi qu’un accès facilité à un interlocuteur dédié. Que vous recherchiez la convivialité d’une colocation ou le confort d’un logement individuel, plusieurs résidences modernes et tout équipées vous sont accessibles. Situées à Massy-Palaiseau, Noisy-le-Grand et Villejuif, elles offrent des appartements connectés, flexibles et en formule tout compris.
L’APL, aide personnalisée au logement concerne les étudiants habitant dans un logement conventionné, comme un logement social ou Crous. L’ALS (Allocation de logement à caractère social) concerne les autres types de logements. Pour obtenir ces aides (de 100 à 250 euros pour une personne seule), rendez-vous sur le site internet de la CAF. Un simulateur vous permettra de connaître le montant de l’aide en fonction de votre situation. On vous conseille de lancer la demande dès la signature de votre bail, le premier versement interviendra normalement un à deux mois après le dépôt du dossier.

public_reference.value:
Housing and Residence Life provides safe, inclusive, and secure residential communities where students are encouraged to pursue academic excellence, personal growth, civic leadership and responsibility.
When students live on campus, they meet each other, study together, and attend UNC Greensboro programs and events together. Most of all, they support and motivate each other. First-year Spartans live in traditional housing because it is the perfect place for incoming students to connect with other newcomers.
Current campus residents are those students who currently live in campus housing and want to apply to live on campus the following year (No Spring Only Application).
You will use Artemis to access everything related to your housing assignment. You will apply, choose or find your room assignment and view your roommate(s)’ information, find room change information, and more! Log in using your iSpartan credentials, and you will see information that is custom-tailored just for you.

public_reference.value:
Create meaningful relationships, explore common interests and put your graduate knowledge into practice through events and opportunities to serve the greater Greensboro community. Live on campus in our graduate student housing called Lofts on Lee, at the bustling Spartan Village – a mix of residential and commercial space.
What if learning could transform an entire community? This inspiring presentation shares how a Physics teacher in Cameroon went beyond the classroom to tackle real-world challenges affecting students’ success. By introducing renewable energy solutions, improving study conditions, and launching a community agribusiness initiative, students gained opportunities to connect science with everyday life. Discover how teachers can become changemakers, empower students, strengthen communities, and use education as a powerful tool for sustainable development.

public_reference.value:
For 2026-2027, we estimate that it will cost an average of £1,546 each month to live in Edinburgh as a single undergraduate student. This equates to £13,914 for a 39-week academic year and £18,552 for a full year. This amount does not include study costs (like tuition fees) and will likely rise each year with inflation.
Find tuition fees and additional study costs on the degree finder
Tuition fee rates for international students are available on the Scholarships and Student Funding website. Fees are listed by course and level (undergraduate, postgraduate or study abroad students).
If you plan to make any regular payments through direct debit (tuition fees, rent or household bills), or are receiving any support loans, it is recommended that you open a bank account in the UK. Learn about your options for opening your first student bank account in the UK on the New Students website.

public_reference.value:
Die Mietpreise liegen zwischen 250 und 400 Euro im Monat. Vor Ihrer Anreise müssen Sie in der Regel die erste Monatsmiete, die Kaution und eine Bearbeitungsgebühr in Höhe von 25 Euro bezahlen.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass auch in Deutschland aktuell die Preise für den Wohnraum und die Nebenkosten ansteigen. Es ist daher wichtig, dass Sie Ihr Budget für Miete und Nebenkosten entsprechend planen. Häufig sind bei den angegebenen Mietpreisen die Stromkosten (oder auch Heizkosten) noch nicht inklusive, daher prüfen Sie die Angebote genau. Sie sollten Preise erwarten im Bereich von:
Zimmer in Studierendenwohnheimen: 252€ - 400€
Die Mietverträge beim Studierendenwerk werden für das ganze Semester abgeschlossen, das heißt bis 30. September oder 31. März. Wenn Sie also ein Zimmer anmieten, müssen Sie für das gesamte Semester bezahlen, auch wenn Sie früher (z.B. im Februar) abreisen! Eine Buchung beim Studierendenwerk ist nur möglich durch Zahlung der Kaution und der ersten Monatsmiete (Vorauszahlung). Je nach Wohnheim beträgt diese Vorauszahlung zwischen 595€ und 1000€. Die Kaution erhalten Sie nach dem Auszug, wenn Sie die Wohnung in ordentlichem Zustand verlassen haben, zurück.

public_reference.value:
For enquiries about accommodation or about an application you're making, contact us at the Student Services Hub. Quote your full name and PRID or PG number on all correspondence.
Accommodation at Essex is more than just a room. It’s your place to connect and thrive, make friends for life, and embrace the moments that make you.
We know that for some of you, moving away from home may seem like a daunting prospect; that’s why at Essex we try our hardest to help you settle in, starting by * guaranteeing accommodation for the duration of your course, *T&C's apply . Giving our students the opportunity to live at the heart of a vibrant community with shared values and diverse interest, in an environment where you will succeed.
If you are paying your own tuition fees, you should also ensure that you have sufficient funds to pay your first term's fees. Please note that you will not be able to pay your tuition or accommodation fees by cash. In addition, contactless payment methods are accepted across the whole campus and contactless is our preferred payment method.

public_reference.value:
There are six levels of Japanese courses which are designed to accommodate the various proficiency levels of the students. The motto of Seikei University is to provide our international students with smaller classes, from a range of 10 pupils or less, which presents an ideal language learning environment. The curriculum includes required subjects that provide overall improvement in the four skills of reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Apart from the required subjects, there are electives such as ,"Tadoku" where there is an opportunity to read a variety of easy Japanese books, and other courses include, "Business Japanese" "Japanese-Language Proficiency Test" "Creating Drama" and "Japanese Affairs."
I am aware of the fact that each exchange student has had a different experience of Japanese instruction. This is a point I keep in mind when I am instructing. I also offer advice about the courses they register with consideration for their future plans. With this in mind, the classes at Seikei University with the exchange students are held mostly with a maximum of 10 students per class. I believe that this number is an ideal amount for a language learning environment. The required subjects' aims are to get the students to improve their skills comprehensively of listening, speaking, reading and writing. These courses are designed for the students of intermediate and advanced levels. The students can also take electives that they are interested in and that match their levels. These are the subjects which make Seikei University's Japanese courses unique. We have lectures tailored for taking the Japanese Language Proficiency Test, and most students pass the test before completing their studies here. In addition to Japanese subjects, "Japanese Affairs" is one of the popular classes. It allows the students to have the opportunity to look at Japan through a variety of lenses, which includes topics such as, politics, economics, society, sports, entertainment and international relations. Please join us here at Seikei University, and I look forward to your arrival here in Japan.

【住居】国際交流会館（留学生寮）の入居者を募集します/Application for International House
Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.
Chiba University International House is an off-campus dormitory for international students. The International House is located within walking distance from JR Inage Station, which is just one station away (2 minutes by train) from the Nishi-Chiba campus. Many students commute to the campus by bicycle (10-15 minutes). It provides rooms for singles, married couples, and families. For more details, visit ISD website

public_reference.value:
The long-stay visa valid as a residence permit, specifically the "student" type (VLS-TS "étudiant"), allows you to study in France for a period of four months to one year. Upon its expiration, you must apply for a residence permit in order to remain in France.
The long-stay visa valid as a residence permit for students (visa long séjour valant titre de séjour "étudiant", abbreviated to VLS-TS "étudiant") allows you to stay in France from four months to one year to pursue higher education studies.
For your stay in France, you have many housing options. You can choose between a publicly owned building or a private one, and between a student residence or an apartment that you may occupy alone, with other students, or with a family or local resident. Don’t panic! We’ll decode the various types of housing available to students and help you in your search.
And don’t forget to ask the staff at your educational institution if they can help. Some institutions (especially the Grandes Ecoles ), maintain a stock of housing or have a system for connecting their students with housing providers.

public_reference.value:
The residences managed by France’s regional centers for student services, known as CROUS ( centres régionaux des œuvres universitaires et scolaires ), are publicly owned and subsidized by the French government. CROUS buildings are the first choice of many students for the advantages they offer : the monthly rent is low (€450 in Paris; €350 on average elsewhere in France). The buildings are close to campus, and the opportunities for social interaction with other students are plentiful. In fact, the only drawback to CROUS rooms is that they are hard to get, because demand far exceeds supply.
4. Lokaviz lists all of the units available in CROUS residences, as well as space offered by individual property owners. There’s no cost to review the posted vacancies. All of the units listed on the site have earned the Lokaviz label, so students can be sure they’re renting decent housing .
Compare what the different banks offer. The costs of the bank card, international transfers and cash withdrawals abroad may vary noticeably from one bank to another.
Vélib’ in Paris, Vélov’ in Lyon and Vélo Bleu in Nice: most big French cities have self-service bicycle rental. An annual subscription – between 15 and 30 euros on average – is the easiest way to use it.

public_reference.value:
交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

We can arrange to visit the famous historical places (such as Wat Phra Kaew and Wat Pho), museums, environmental conservation stations, and an international company that can address some of the issues related to cross-border trade and the importance of developing cross-cultural competency skills.
We will try to introduce visiting international students to our Thai students, to integrate the academic experience. Often, the Thai Buddies build friendships that endure outside the classroom.
The academic component will involve some in-class sessions at one of Kasetsart Unive

public_reference.value: The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg

Spring 2027 exchange students can find the details of accommodation application on this page.
Students interested in opting out of KGU-Arranged accommodations should carefully read the Advice to Self-Arranged Accommodation Students before making a final decision.
Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.
There are three dormitories for male students—Keimeiryo, Seishuryo, and Seizenryo.

L’université de Poitiers organise des mobilités d’étudiants, d’enseignants et de personnels administratifs dans les universités partenaires en
Europe, grâce au soutien financier du programme Erasmus+ KA131.
Les étudiants ont ainsi, grâce à ce programme, l’opportunité d’effectuer une mobilité d’études ou de stage dans un établissement européen dans le cadre de leur cursus.

public_source_checks.link_label: International Program Ph.D. in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (International Program) Ph.D. in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (International Program) Embark on a transformative journey with Bangkok University’s Ph.D. program in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (Ph.D. KIM). Established in 2011, this research-based program is designed for aspiring researchers, academics, and professionals seeking to explore the role of knowledge and innovation in societal and organizational development. The program accommodates working professionals through fully online learning, with classes scheduled on Saturdays. Students benefit from the guidance of international experts, a global network of professionals, and personalized academic support. Study Plans The program offers two study plans based on applicants’ academic qualifications: Plan 1.1 — For Applicants Holding a Master’s Degree 3 years | 48 credits Plan 1.2 — For Applicants Holding a Bachelor’s Degree 4 years | 72 credits Both plans include preliminary courses in advanced research methodology and seminars on Knowledge Management and Innovation Management, a Qualifying Examination, and dissertation research. Job Opportunities Chief Knowledge OfficerChief Learning OfficerIntellectual Capital DirectorKnowledge Management ExecutiveHuman Resource DirectorInnovation Development DirectorKnowledge Management and Innovation Management Expert For more information and applications: https://phdkim.bu.ac.th Note: Applicants holding a bachelor’s degree who wish to apply for Plan 1.2 must have at least 10 years of professional experience in Knowledge Management or Innovation Management. 大学・大学院への進学を見据え、日本語能力や情報活用能力等の学術活動の基礎となる能力を養うことができます。
大学・大学院への進学を見据え、日本語能力や情報活用能力等の学術活動の基礎となる能力を養うことができます。
関西大学では 学生交換協定 に基づき、協定大学から毎年4月と9月に外国人学生を交換受入留学生として受け入れています。本プログラムで受けられる授業科目は「外国人留学生科目」と「KUGF科目」に分かれ、「外国人留学生科目」は日本語で、「KUGF科目」は英語で授業を行います。さらにプレースメントテストにより十分な日本語能力があると判断された学生は、各学部で開講している科目についても受講できる可能性があります。なお、関西大学の担当教員の大学院演習科目の履修を希望する場合は、問い合わせ先よりお問合せください。
留学生別科は、原則として１年の課程です。本別科は、本学の学部・大学院や日本国内の大学・大学院への進学を希望する外国人に対し、日本語・日本事情・日本文化などを教授することを目的としています。日本語能力に加え、進学に必要な学術活動の基礎能力の養成も積極的に支援します。

UMA does NOT offer accommodation to students , but offers help in finding accommodation through the International Hub, the Accommodation Service or ESN Malaga.
The Social Action Service of the University of Malaga has an Accommodation Programme with the aim of enabling the search for rented housing through online access to the computer application created for this purpose, where all the formalities are carried out completely FREE of charge, both for those interested in looking for accommodation and for landlords who offer their homes to the university community.

交換留学とは、本学の学生交換協定校へ龍谷大学の代表として派遣されるもので、学費の免除はもちろん、協定校によっては奨学金を受けることも可能な制度です。原則として毎年同数の学生を派遣・受け入れしています。
留学期間は原則1年間または半年間です。その間の龍谷大学の学費も免除となりますが、留学在籍料が必要です。なお、留学先大学の都合により、年度途中であっても、条件が変更になる場合や、募集を行わない場合がありますので、最新の情報はグローバル教育推進センターホームページで確認して下さい。

content_review.quote:
外国留学生招生简章
 百年老校、历史悠久
 国际交流与合作广泛
 课程建设齐备、师资力量雄厚
 留学生项目
百年老校、历史悠久
贵州大学成立于 1902 年，秉承“明
德至善 博学笃行”的校训，坚持以兴学
育人为根本，立足贵州、服务地方，努力
建设有特色领军型高水平大学。贵州大学
是国家“211 工程”重点建设大学；2012
年，被列为国家“中西部高校综合能力提
GUIZHOU UNIVERSITY

升工程”14 所高校之一；2016 年 5 月，成为中西部“一省一校”重点大
学建设工程高校 ；2017 年 9 月，成为国家世界一流学科建设高校；2018
年 2 月，成为教育部、贵州省人民政府“部省合建”高校。
贵州大学占地面积4646亩，
设有 40 个学院、专业涵盖哲学、
经济学、法学、文学、历史学、
教育学、理学、工学、农学、管
理学、艺术学、医学等 12 个学科
门类。在校全日制学生 45973 人；
在职职工 3841 人，其中专任教师
2395 人。有一级学科博士学位授
权点 17 个、二级学科博士学位授权点 77 个；一级学科硕士学位授权点 49
个、二级学科硕士学位授权点 197 个、专业硕士学位授权点 17 个；普通
高等教育本科专业 137 个。
学校现有世界一流建设学科 1 个（植物保护）、国家级重点学科 1 个
（农药学）、国家一流建设学科 5 个（农林经济管理、大数据科学及技术、
生态学、生物学等）、区域一流建设学科 1 个（土木工程）、省级特色重点
学科 23 个。
国际交流与合作广泛
贵州大学十分重视国际交流与合作，与 40 多个国家和地区的 150 余
所高校或研究机构建立了交流与合作关系，2018 年招收来自 58 个国家和
地区的超过 1000 名长短期留学生。
与美国普莱斯比学院、冈
比亚大学共建孔子学院；2008
年以来，承办或协办了 11 届
“中国—东盟教育交流周”；
是教育部教育援外基地、中国
政府奖学金来华留学生培养
院校、孔子学院奖学金来华留学生培养院校、贵州省政府奖学金来黔留学
生培养院校、教育部区域和国别研究基地—东盟研究中心；先后成为 IAUP
（国际大学校长联盟）、AUAP（亚太大学联盟）、东盟大学联盟等国际组织
成员。

课程建设齐备、师资力量雄厚
贵州大学招收留学生始于 20 世纪 80 年
代，办学历史源远流长，现国际教育学院拥有
一支教学经验丰厚，学历结构分布合理的教师
队伍，为留学生开设零基础、初级、中级、高
级四个层次的汉语及中国文化课程。此外，组
织形式多样的课外活动及文化体验，让留学生
在学习之余能充分体验中国文化和贵州少数
民族文化及人文风情。国际教育学院帮助留学
生高效地提高汉语语言及文化素养，为留学生
在贵州大学学习优秀学位项目打下坚实基础。

UNA promueve el intercambio académico internacional con “Abriendo fronteras”
Publicado el:
23 / septiembre / 2026
La Universidad Nacional de Asunción (UNA) llevó a cabo el encuentro “Abriendo fronteras”, un espacio de intercambio entre estudiantes del extranjero que realizan movilidad académica en la UNA y estudiantes nacionales que desarrollaron experiencias de movilidad en el extranjero durante el primer semestre d este año. La actividad se desarrolló el jueves 17 de septiembre, en el campus de la UNA, San Lorenzo.
El encuentro contó con la presencia de la Prof. Dra. Zully Vera de Molinas, rectora de la UNA; el Prof. Dr. Miguel Torres Ñumbay, vicerrector; el Prof. Dr. Édgar Sánchez, director general de Postgrado y Relaciones Internacionales (DGPRI-UNA); el Dr. Francisco Ramírez, director de Relaciones Internacionales (DRI-DGPRI-UNA); además de decanas decanos, vicedecanos, estudiantes de Paraguay y representantes de países extranjeros. La Facultad de Ciencias Químicas de la Universidad Nacional de Asunción (FCQ-UNA) es sede de la VIII Conferencia Internacional de la Red Emérita ValSe-Food del CYTED y las VI Jornadas de Alimentos, dos encuentros científicos y académicos que reúnen a investigadores, docentes, profesionales y referentes del ámbito de las ciencias de los alimentos de Paraguay y otros países.
La ceremonia de apertura se realizó el martes 6 de octubre, en el Salón Auditorio de la FCQ-UNA, con la participación de autoridades universitarias, representantes de la Red ValSe-Food y referentes del ámbito científico. La Prof. Dra. Zully Vera de Molinas, rectora de la UNA, acompañó el inicio de las actividades, junto a integrantes de la comunidad académica.

INTERNACIONALIZACIÓN - Universidad Nacional de Asunción

La Prof. Dra. Zully Vera de Molinas, rectora de la Universidad Nacional de Asunción (UNA), recibió en su despacho a docentes investigadores de universidades de Chile y Colombia, en el marco del XIV Congreso de la Sociedad Latinoamericana de Biología Matemática (Solabima 2026), que se desarrolla por primera vez en Paraguay, en la Facultad Politécnica…
La Dra. Griselda Meza Ocampos, investigadora del Centro Multidisciplinario de Investigaciones Tecnológicas de la Universidad Nacional de Asunción (CEMIT-UNA), participó en un seminario científico en el marco de la “Conferencia Mundial de la FAO sobre Medidas relativas a Una sola salud (One Health) en los Sistemas Agroalimentarios”, llevado a cabo en la sede central de…
La Prof. Lic. Sady Cáceres Sequera, profesional de la Incubadora de Empresas de la Universidad Nacional de Asunción (INCUNA) y del Departamento de Emprendedores de la Facultad Politécnica (FP-UNA), obtuvo el tercer puesto en el certamen audiovisual de la campaña “K-Journey”. Esta iniciativa fue impulsada por la Agencia de Cooperación Internacional de Corea (KOICA) para…

public_reference.value:
まず、日本語能力の向上という点において、大きな成果を得ることができました。韓国にいる間も、学校の言語交換プログラムに参加したりと、日本語にたくさん触れるよう努力していましたが、やはり限界がありました。実際に日本で生活しながら、日本人の学生と一緒に授業を受けたりすることで、生きた日本語や日常表現に触れることができました。また、言語に対する自分自身の情熱や興味、今後の学業や進路についても改めて考える貴重な機会となりました。
交換留学生活を通じて、日本語能力が全体的に向上しただけでなく、日本人学生と共に授業を受け、ディスカッションを行う中で、実生活で活用できる実践的な日本語表現やコミュニケーション能力を身につけることができました。さらに、日本の学生の考え方を直接体験することで、メディアを通して知っていた日本社会を超え、文化や価値観の違いをより深く理解するようになりました。加えて、慣れない環境で一人暮らしをしながら、授業や課題、日常生活を自分自身で管理する経験を通して、新しい状況にも柔軟に対応できる適応力と自立心が大きく成長したと感じています。これらの経験は、今後の人生において重要な財産になると考えています。

さらに、約 3 ヶ月間の短い期間ではありますが、カフェでアルバイトもしました。授業や友人との会話とは異なり、「働く」という責任を持って日本語を使う貴重な機会でした。韓国ではカフェでのアルバイト経験がなかったため、最初は業務を覚えるのに苦労しましたが、非常に有意義な経験となり、日本語能力の向上にも大きく役立ったと感じています。

public_reference.value: Getting through the paperwork felt a bit daunting at first, but thanks to the kind people at the International Office I had help whenever I needed it, and if there was something I didn't understand they would help. There is also a lively community of international students, and you can easily get to know a lot of friendly people, both Japanese and foreign. There are three levels of Japanese language classes for exchange students, and since I didn't feel too confident in my language skills, Gakushuin kindly allowed me to attend classes from two levels at once: professors were friendly and openly encouraged conversation and mingling between the international students in the class. Even when I had a question about grammar or vocabulary, they would take time to explain it to me so that I could understand.

public_reference.value:
学習院で過ごした一学期間生活は日本を体験できるいい機会になりました。日本語実力を上達したいなら学校で提供するプログラムに参加することが役に立つと思います。韓国語を日本の友だちに教えるプログラムもありますし、 SA(Student Assistant) とペアになって自分が足りないと感じる部分を教えてもらうこともできます。そして、 色々な所に旅行に行くこともおすすめです。東京内にも見どころが十分ありますし、東京は交通が便利で新幹線やバスで千葉、名古屋、仙台など旅行して、思い出をつくることができました。これ以外にもサークルに入って、日本人の友達もつくったり、専攻授業にも参加することなど学習院大学で修学している間、日本文化体験を含め、多様な経験ができました。
私は日本にいる間、行きたいところは全部行ってみようという思いで過ごしました。友達といろんな都会で旅行するのも良かったし、田舎や交通が劣悪なところを一人で旅行するのも幸せでした。旅行が好きだったらぜひ、後悔なく、行きたいところを思う存分楽しんでください。

留学生Q&A
留学生Q&A
引越しをしたら、何かすることはありますか？
以下の6つの手続きを行ってください。
G-Portで住所変更を行う。
保証人が自分の場合、教務課で保証人住所変更も行う（書類提出）。
新しい住所の区（市）役所に行って、住民登録を行う。
国際センターに、住民票を提出する。
郵便局に、郵便物の転送届けを出す（引越し前でもできます）。
国民健康保険の住所変更手続きを行う。
VISAの期限がもうすぐ切れるのですが...
下記「在学関係」ページの「在留期間の更新」をご確認ください。
在留関係「在留期間の更新」
アルバイトはできますか？
在留関係「資格外活動」
一時帰国（日本から出国）する前に、何をすれば良いのですか？
在留関係「一時出国および再入国」
学費延納についての相談があるのですが...
学生課（中央教育研究棟１階）に相談してください。
奨学金（外部）を受給したいのですが...
G-port及び留学生用の掲示板（東1号館1階・国際センター）を確認して応募してください。自由応募のものと、大学から推薦して応募するものがあるので、G-port及び掲示をよく見てください。
「
外国人学生のための奨学金
」にも掲載しています。
履修に関する質問があるのですが...
履修要覧やシラバスをよく読んで、わからなければ教務課（中央教育研究棟１階）に相談してください。
就職活動が不安なのですが...
キャリアセンター（西５号館４階）に相談してください。
なお、留学生の就職実績は以下大学HP「情報公開」の「公表情報」より確認できますので、参考にしてください。

参考）授業料減免・奨学金制度
A：入学手続時に既に日本国内に居住し、「留学」の在留資格を有している場合
現在の在留期限が2027年1月～5月までに満了する者が、2027年4月入学前の「在留期間更新」の対象です。在留期限に応じて「在留期間更新」の申請を各自で行ってください。在留期限満了の3か月前より、出入国在留管理を所管する行政庁（以下、「出入国在留管理局」という）への申請が可能です。入学前の3月初旬までに速やかに、出入国在留管理局で期間更新の手続を完了してください。
申請手順
１　自身の在留期限を確認
2027年1月～5月までに満了する者が対象です。
２　申請書を作成し、本学に提出
本学所定の様式に必要事項を記入し、「受験番号+カナ氏名
（再入学は受験番号不要）
」でファイルを保存して、各入試の入学手続締切日までにメールで送信してください。本学への申請が遅れた場合、入学までに在留期間の更新が間に合わない場合があります。
様式
「在留資格に関する申請書および入学許可証発行願」
※メールの件名に「在留資格に関する申請書および入学許可証発行願」と入力してください。
３　本学から書類を受領
本学にて入学手続の完了が確認でき次第、2027年1月より順次郵送します。
４　必要書類を揃えて出入国在留管理局へ申請
必要書類については、出入国在留管理庁のホームページ等で確認してください。
※所属する学校等の変更について、変更後14日以内に本人が出入国在留管理局に届け出ることになっています（活動機関に関する届出）。
詳細は下記、出入国在留管理庁ウェブサイトでご確認ください。
出入国在留管理庁ウェブサイト

長期滞在が可能な在留資格を有している場合、「留学」への資格変更の義務はありませんが、在学中、私費外国人留学生のための学内・学外の各種奨

School of International Studies
​
​
The School of International Studies (SIS) is a premier institution for the study of International Relations and Area Studies in the country. Established in 1955, SIS is currently celebrating its seventieth anniversary this year. In the seven decades of its existence, SIS has made a pioneering contribution to promoting the study of International Relations and Area Studies in India and advancing knowledge and understanding of international affairs through theoretical and inter-disciplinary lenses.
History:
Of all the Schools of the University, SIS lays claim to the longest history as it was established in 1955 as the
Indian School of International Studies
(ISIS). The need for an institution devoted to the study of international and global developments was felt in the early post-independence years as India prepared to define and assert its position in the global system.

public_reference.value:
Hanwoori House, opened in February 1999, is located at a place with the most spectacular view in our campus. The dormitory consists of Building 101 for undergraduate students, Building 102 (Soseul-gwan) for students who study for state examination and Building 103 which opened in February 2016. Hanwoori House can accommodate approximately 1,330 residents and it plays an important role in cultivating intercultural communication and ewhaen spirit among residents.
Soseul-gwan is a dormitory for ewhaen Law School students, preparing for the bar exam to be laywers and leaders. With about 130 single rooms and 110 double rooms, Soseul-gwan consist of various facilities such as reading room, study room, seminar room, auditory room and computer room. Providing the superior academic environment, Soseul-gwan offers the best support for the future legal experts.
If you decide to study in Korea, it’s important to explore the various housing options available. Find your ideal living environment and contract type through apps that
				provide detailed information.

Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.

public_reference.reason: 五份指定模板有限重試後HTTP200，原檔SHA256與PDF／Word內文均核對；首次503留存歷史。連結由AY2027簡章p.8確認，Word自身未載年度、英語表內AY2026課表僅參考。淡江當期提名未核實。

public_reference.value:
We are proud of our student housing because it's more than just a simple room or apartment. We offer a variety of services and activities to create a feeling of community and we continue to renovate and upgrade facilities to meet the ever-changing needs of our student body. Living Learning Communities offer a specialized living experience with connections to faculty and staff to create supportive communities that focus on student success. Residence Life teams across all communities foster learning through interactions with roommates, floormates, community programs, clubs and activities.
ZeeMee is how future and new Florida Tech students connect, make friends, and find roommates. Download the ZeeMee app and use the channels on our page to connect with potential roommates. New students can request roommates on their housing application.

答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

public_reference.value:
TJU will provide on campus accommodation for exchange students. The rate is about 60 rmb/night. Both Weijin Road Campus and Peiyang Park Campus of Tianjin University have international student dormitories. The campus allocation for international students is uniformly arranged by the university based on the current year's policies and the location of the campus of the international student's major. International students need to reserve online. If they are unable to reserve accommodation on campus successfully, the university will provide off campus accommodation information for students to choose from. Please pay attention to the internal notifications of Tianjin University International Student Service System for details . The introduction for accommodation can be download below.
Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. Foreigners who hold a valid residence permit and have changed passports or had other items on the residence permit changed shall apply to the exit and entry administration authority of public security organs for information update within 10 days from the date the changes occur.
在大陆停居留的台湾居民应当按照《中国公民往来台湾地区管理办法》的规定办理住宿登记后申请办理台胞证。
台湾居民在大陆向出入境管理机构申请换发或补发台湾居民来往大陆通行证时，发现其未办理住宿登记。

The Weijin Road Campus, which includes the Qilitai neighborhood and Pengxiang Apartments, accommodates over 10,000 students living in 13 dormitory buildings. Currently, the standard accommodation arrangements are as follows: six undergraduates share a room, four graduate students share a room, and two PhD students share a room. Dormitory fees vary according to the students' degree; the fee for undergraduates and graduate students is 1,200 yuan per person per year , while for PhD students, it is 800 yuan per person per year .
The standard accommodation arrangement consists of: four undergraduates sharing a room, two graduate students sharing a room, and PhD students residing in individual rooms. 1927年，李书田应北洋大学校长刘仙洲之邀返校任教，讲授土木工程专业的课程，开始了他长达近60年的教育生涯。李书田重视教学与科研相结合，除了在北洋任教外，还担任华北水利委员会的委员兼秘书长一职。1930年，李书田到交通大学唐山土木工程学院任院长，到校不及一年就为该校添设了矿冶工程系和研究院，促进了唐山地区的科研事业。1931年4月，在李书田的努力下，中国水利工程学会得以建立，他任该学会副会长。1932年9月，李书田任北洋工学院（北洋大学当时的校名）院长。此后5年间，他为学校发展做了大量卓有成效的工作：学校的工程学馆、工程实验馆、新图书馆相继竣工并投入使用；学校多种学术期刊蓬勃发展；重新创作了校歌；各系增设了近20个实验室，增添了设备；1935年，学校创办“工科研究所”，开创了研究生培养的先河，使北洋工学院成为国内高校中最早招收研究生的大学之一；他力促建成了“天津水工实验所”，后改称“中国第一水工实验所”。1937年2月，李书田制定了《国立北洋大学筹备缘起及分期完成计划》，提出了用16年时间，将北洋大学建设成为工理文法医相结合的综合性一流大学的奋斗目标。

中国实行右侧通行，机动车驾驶位在左侧。行人需在人行道内行走，电动自行车、电动三轮车等需登记后方可上路行驶。乘坐公共交通时，公交车遵循 “前门上车、后门下车” 规则，地铁内禁止大声喧哗和饮食。建议通过《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》官网查询详细规定。​
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

Budapest has a wide range of rental options: shared flats, student residences and private studios. Students are encouraged to start their accommodation search early, especially for the autumn semester, when demand is high. Incoming students typically use local housing platforms, Facebook groups and dedicated student rental sites.
Non-EU/EEA students may require a visa or residence permit depending on their nationality and length of stay. Students should check the specific requirements well before travelling. After arrival, certain nationalities may need to complete local registration steps or extend their residence permit. Corvinus offers guidance, but students are responsible for submitting their own applications.

All foreign nationals with a residence permit for a period exceeding 3 months who are students or who are not covered by an employer’s social security plan (mutual aid, health insurance) are required to join National Health Insurance. National Health Insurance is especially beneficial in cases of serious disease or hospitalization thanks to its reimbursement system: if the total sum of medical bills that a single medical institution charges to a subscriber within 1 month exceeds a certain amount, the excess sum is reimbursed to the subscriber.

public_reference.value:
一、学历生及语言生必须在报到注册的当天支付来华留学生保险费，线上提交缴费凭证，才能完成报到手续；需缴纳学费及住宿费的学生，请于2026年9月8日前完成支付。未按照要求在规定时间内交纳学费及住宿费者予以退学并取消学籍。
B类：涵盖学费、住宿费及综合医疗保险费。 C类：涵盖学费及综合医疗保险费。
座谈会上，国际学生代表结合自身在校学习生活实际，围绕住宿管理、学业发展、奖助服务、校园文化活动、实习就业、毕业离校等重点事项，积极反馈现存问题、主动建言献策，为学院精准改进管理服务、补齐工作短板提供了宝贵参考依据。
与会教师对照学校规章制度、结合办学实际与现有资源，对学生提出的疑问和建议逐一细致回应、逐条答疑说明，并明确后续优化举措。学院将积极联动有关职能部门及相关培养学院，持续优化住宿管理模式，统筹兼顾校园安全规范与人文暖心服务；整合优质教学资源，丰富学术交流平台，助力学生夯实学业基础、提升专业能力；不断丰富校园文体活动，细化实习就业帮扶举措，完善校园配套保障，全方位提升国际学生在校学习生活体验。
public_reference.reason: 接待校官方公開原文參考；來源年度、校區及淡江提名計畫對應尚未核實。不能當作本期母校申請資格或文件。

public_reference.value:
International students are required to show tuition for 2 academic semesters +  estimated living expenses of $15,000 + $8700 in estimated fees for books,  health insurance and supplies etc. To determine your estimated fees:
Regardless of whether you live on campus or off  campus, you will have living expenses. This includes rent, utilities,  groceries, etc.    Living expenses are currently estimated at $15,000.00 per year. This sum must be added to the tuition and fees listed at https://bursar.temple.edu/tuition-and-fees/tuition-rates .
If you have a friend or family member who will be supplying room and board, they can complete the form available at https://isss.temple.edu/file/room-and-board-affidavitpdf. That form should be uploaded  and will  cover the estimated living expenses of $15,00.00. You would be responsible for provided financial documentation that covered the tuition and the estimated fees for  books, insuract etc which are set at $4,000.00

If you need to travel between campuses, UQ offers a free shuttle bus service that connects our St Lucia and Gatton campuses.
You can catch the free UQ Intercampus bus from the St Lucia campus – Chancellors Place, to the Gatton campus (runs four times per day Monday to Friday only). You must book a seat at least one (1) business day before your journey, using your UQ Student ID number as reference. Please refer to the current UQ Intercampus Bus Timetable when planning your journey (refer to the West Bound, St Lucia to Gatton service when travelling to Gatton).

You need an agreement between your home university and the VUB that will allow you to  come and spend one or two semester(s) at VUB as an exchange student. During your exchange, you will have to take different courses at VUB, so it is important to check our course offer (see below ‘study fields’) and discuss it with your coordinator.
If you are interested in a study exchange, there is a certain procedure to follow, that starts with an application at your home university based on your grades, study field, level of studies, etc. Then, if your home university agrees, you can start the procedure at VUB. public_reference.value:
SFSU has a variety of housing communities, room types and meal plans for you to choose from. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Ready to apply? Click the link below to learn about the application process, important application dates and deadlines, and to find answers to housing application FAQs.
Whether you prefer traditional residence hall, suite, or apartment-style housing, SFSU has a variety of housing communities and room types. Whatever you’re looking for, we have a space that’s right for you.
Curious about what it’s really like to live on campus? In-person housing tours will be available this summer for students attending orientation and throughout the year as part of the main campus tour. These tours will give you the chance to explore the inside of select communities and ask any questions you may have. There’s no better way to picture your future home away from home.

public_reference.value:
All housing and meal plan fees are subject to change. Download Acrobat Reader to view PDF files.
As a benefit of living on campus, residents will have $100,000 in liability insurance provided for them through SF State and GradGuard. This liability coverage is included in your housing fees and protects you financially in the event you cause unintentional damage to your room or apartment due to fire, smoke, explosion, or the discharge of a sprinkler head.
To cancel a housing application or decline a space prior to the fee period, applicants are required to provide a 15-day cancellation notice in order to receive a refund of the initial payment. Applicants who have not yet submitted the initial payment may cancel at any time.
Find your new home! Before you apply, take a virtual tour of our residential community and explore our available housing options. Once you've identified your preferred community and room type, review the associated housing fees and meal plan requirements for your selected community.

Located on the Seoul campus, Sameuiwon is a newly renovated dormitory complex that can accommodate 392 students. Both Korean and international students may opt to live in this dormitory. The rooms are equipped with beds, desks, cabinets, air conditioners, LAN, and land phones for the comfort of students. Generally four students share each room.

public_reference.value:
We are still taking accommodation applications for September 2026. Invitation emails will continue to be sent. Please take the time to look at our halls and application information.
Accommodation is still available in university-managed or approved accommodation. Please submit your accommodation application via the accommodation portal by 2 September 2026 to be allocated accommodation on 4 September 2026. Allocation is subject to the applicant holding an unconditional offer to study by 2 September.
Did you know that everyone coming to study full-time at Oxford Brookes can apply for our halls? We guarantee accommodation for students who make us their firm choice and apply by the deadline.
Run by elected students, for students, the students’ union is here to help with a range of issues including finance, academic and housing. They will also help you join or set up a student group and run events.

We have a number of different accommodation types to meet the needs of disabled students and those with medical conditions.
We do not currently offer any accommodation suitable for students based on the Swindon Campus.

public_reference.value:
The opening of Suffolk's sixth residence hall represents an exciting new chapter for both students and downtown Boston.
Your studies and college life in Boston extend well beyond the classroom thanks to our downtown location. As a Suffolk student, you'll have the best of both university and city worlds right outside your door, with on-campus dining, University housing, and student services, as well as all the sights, sounds, and excitement of a major downtown hub. Boston's arts and entertainment scene, diverse cuisine, history, public transportation, and more will form the dynamic backdrop of your college experience.
University Housing Visit Off Campus Housing Summer Housing Dining Options Student Resources
Suffolk University offers resources for students searching for off-campus housing. We can help you get started with finding a roommate and available housing in the Boston area. You can also contact us if you have any additional questions.

Dirección de Relaciones Internacionales
Es una unidad adscrita a la Rectoría cuya misión es manejar las relaciones con universidades del exterior, organismos y agencias internacionales, así como la promoción, planificación, coordinación, seguimiento y evaluación de planes, programas y proyectos de cooperación internacional con miras a potenciar la calidad de la docencia, la investigación y la extensión de la UTP.
Para cumplir con esta misión, la
Dirección de Relaciones Internacionales (DRI)
gestiona convenios internacionales que son utilizados como marco de acción conjunta entre las unidades internas y los socios internacionales.

ABOUT US
"The International Affairs Office, a unit attached to the Rector's Office, plays a vital role in overseeing and facilitating the university's international engagements. Its primary responsibilities encompass managing relationships with foreign universities, international organizations, and agencies. Additionally, the office is responsible for promoting, planning, coordinating, monitoring, and evaluating international cooperation plans, programs, and projects. By fostering effective international collaborations, the office strives to enhance the quality of teaching, research, and extension activities at Universidad Tecnológica de Panamá (UTP)."

course_restrictions.label: 課程限制

values.value:
※申請者必須在申請時以及於就讀秋田國際教養大學期間，皆為其淡江大學的在學學生，其成績單上必須已顯示至少兩個學期在該校修習的成績。
Applicants must be enrolled at TKU both at the time of application and during their stay at Akita International University, and have at least two semesters of grades from TKU reflected on their transcript.

※轉學生：必須已在淡江完成至少一個學期，且該學期的成績需反映在成績單上。來自先前學校的成績單將不被接受。
They must have completed at least one semester at TKU, with grades for that semester reflected on their transcript. Transcripts from previous institutions are not accepted.

public_reference.value:
Affordability is a key factor in choosing a university. UW-Stout Polytechnic is ranked as one of the United States' most affordable public universities. Be sure to compare apples to apples when considering other schools, and examine factors such as what your tuition and residence hall fees include, on-campus employment, internships, and scholarships .
At UW-Stout Polytechnic, we provide on-campus employment opportunities and paid internships with our industry partners. As an on-campus, undergraduate student your tuition and residence hall fees include textbooks, a laptop with software, and all of the essentials for your room. Plus, we have thousands of dollars in scholarships set aside specifically for international students.
Housing staff is available by phone or video chat (on Microsoft Teams) Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Many international students live and eat on campus. The housing contract reserves your room and meal plan for the school year, and you can also choose to live on campus during the summer ( no summer meal plan available ). Suite-style housing may be available on campus. On-campus graduate housing is most likely not available.  For some students choosing to live off campus, costs are similar, depending upon the type of apartment or shared house.

public_reference.value:
Accommodation rental includes water, electricity and network fees; single bed (bedstead), desk and wardrobe are provided. There is a washroom, a bathroom, a balcony, a ceiling fan and network socket in each hostel room (students may bring their own network cables). In each floor there is a lounge, a water dispenser and fire security control system. 24-hour security and CCTV system are also provided.
NEUC hostel provides not only facilities for accommodation but also opportunities for students to experience group living and to nurture capabilities for self-governance and self-discipline.

材料复合新技术国际联合实验室（国家国际联合研究中心）
发布：2023-11-07
分享
材料复合新技术国际联合实验室是科技部、国家外专局于
2007
年首批批准的
33
个国家国际科技合作重点科研机构之一，依托单位为武汉理工大学，实验室主任为中国工程院院士傅正义教授。
国际联合实验室瞄准世界材料科学前沿和国家重大需求，构建国际一流水平的材料复合与制备技术平台，研制国家重大工程和支柱产业发展需要的先进复合材料，为国家战略提供支撑；在变革性技术和前沿新材料及其交叉领域，产生具有国际影响力的原创性和系统性研究成果，在若干战略性前沿新材料研究方面引领国际发展；以卓越科学研究引领材料科学与工程世界一流学科的拔尖创新人才培养；营造国际协同创新文化，开展“强－强”国际合作研究，增强实验室的国际影响力、吸引力和凝聚力。
国际联合实验室以创建和发展材料多组分、多尺度、多层次复合原理与材料设计理论为重要引领，以构建材料梯度复合技术、原位复合技术、纳米复合技术及其集成创新平台为核心支撑，以研究面向国家重大工程和支柱产业的先进复合材料、面向新能源技术的高效能源转换和储存材料、面向生命科学的纳米复合生物材料、面向信息技术的信息功能材料和面向变革性技术的前沿新材料等五类关键材料为重大任务，形成了如下特色鲜明的五个研究方向：梯度复合技术与新材料、原位复合技术与新材料、纳米复合技术与新材料、变革性技术与前沿新材料、材料复合原理与材料设计。
国际联合实验室现有固
定人员100名，其中包括领军科学家两院院士3人，发达国家院士3人；国家级高层次人才24人，国家级 “四青”人才29人；英国皇家化学会会士、美国物理学会会士、美国陶瓷学会会士10人，汤森路透和科睿唯安 “全球高被引科学家”4人；来自国际著名大学和研究机构的外方研究人员26人。
国际联合实验室与美国密歇根大学、日本航空宇宙技术开发机构、日本东北大学金属材料研究所、英国牛津大学材料研究中心、美国加州大学复合材料研究中心、加拿大燃料电池国家研究院等国际著名研究机构开展了实质性的“强—强”合作。国家外专局和教育部依托实验室建立了“材料复合新技术与先进功能材料”、“功能薄膜新材料先进制备技术与应用工程”和“生命复合材料学科创新引智基地”等3个学科创新引智基地，依托这些重要的国际合作平台，实验室承担了一批国家重点国际合作项目，国际合作与交流取得了丰硕的成果。
在
2014
年和
2020
年国家首次、第二次国际联合实验室评估中，实验室都被评估为优秀。国际联合实验室已经成为在国际材料科学技术领域具有重要影响的国际合作研究、学术交流和拔尖创新人才合作培养的基地。

分享
2017年9月，根据教育部关于“转化医学与临床研究”等国际合作联合实验室立项建设的通知（教技函〔2017〕52号），我校材料复合新技术与新材料国际合作联合实验室获准立项建设。
材料复合新技术与新材料国际合作联合实验室依托材料复合新技术国家重点实验室，选择美国加州大学欧文分校和日本东北大学等高校和研究机构为主要的合作伙伴，通过深度联合，共同打造材料复合新技术与新材料技术研发平台，吸引对方国家和其他国家的优秀人才到中国开展合作研究和共同研发。经过多年科学技术研究的实践，在国内外材料科学技术领域中形成了自己的鲜明特色。科学研究工作的重点集中高效能源转换材料与器件、结构／功能一体化复合材料、生物医用与生命复合材料、信息功能材料与器件、材料复合新技术与复合原理等五个方向，推动武汉理工大学材料优势学科向质量提升为核心的内涵式发展，显著提升武汉理工大学材料学科的国际影响力和国际竞争力。

Campus Life Art & Culture Sports & Facilities Students’ Associations Banking Campus Canteens Stores and Supermarkets Campus Accommodation Post Offices Hospitals Campus Bus Transportation
What is the most important thing in college students’ life? Apart from the romantically infused sight of cherry blossoms in spring and the wisdom imparted by teachers to the studious, commuting remains a common concern. Transportation is significant for a campus that covers 5915 acres , with teaching and living facilities scattered around. Thanks to the efforts of Wuhan University (WHU), several measures have been taken to improve students’ commute inside this large campus.
For most students, electric bicycles and school buses are the top two choices to cope with hilly streets and little travel time. However, electric bicycles are dangerous for drivers and school buses can be time-consuming. Improving measures related to these two means of transport have become one of the greatest concerns of the relevant university authorities, resulting in several changes.

Upon acceptance into the program, students will receive a room application form along with their admission documents. In order to apply for accommodation on-campus, students should follow the instructions provided on the form. Due to high demand and limited resources, room allocation is based on a “first come, first served” principle. Therefore, international students who plan to live on-campus are advised to apply for their room as soon as they receive their admission package.
The Renmin University of China provides two types of dormitory rooms to the international students:
Foreigners who need to stay in China after the expiration of residence permits shall apply for an extension 30 days before the expiration. Foreigners who hold a valid residence permit and have changed passports or had other items on the residence permit changed shall apply to the exit and entry administration authority of public security organs for information update within 10 days from the date the changes occur.

答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

public_reference.value:
Step 3: The teaching and training units of Jilin University conduct further review, remote interview or written test .
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

3. International students living in the Xianlin campus’s student dormitory should pay their room fees according to the stipulated time period. Rent may be paid by semester or by school year.
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.

public_reference.value:
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.

public_reference.value:
We’re proud to be able to provide accommodation to all undergraduate students who require it. All our undergraduate freshers (first-year students) are housed on our main college site, right in the heart of Oxford. You’ll be at the centre of our college community, close to the common room and dining hall, and living alongside other new students.
Graduate applicants who receive either a conditional or unconditional offer from Hertford are invited to apply for college accommodation via a separate application form sent by the Hertford Accommodation Office.
Application process Applications are processed in three allocation rounds (normally April, May and June). Following each round, applicants will either: receive an accommodation offer; or be notified that they remain under consideration for the next round. Applicants who are unsuccessful after the final round may join a waiting list. If you have a disability or medical requirement affecting accommodation, this must be declared in your application and registered with the University’s Disability Advisory Service (DAS) so that it can be prioritised during the allocation process.

Students must submit required documents for extension by mid-January and mid-July every year.

Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.

Niveau C1 pour les enseignements d’Information & Communication.
